$comment: Hand-labeled from the pinned sample source (scripts/samples.json), not from Concentrate output. Routes: every route the production router files register, with the full path its group gets in hello.go (gin joins a group path and "" to the group path, and keeps a trailing slash); routes the tests register are out of scope. Calls: every call site in the production Go files (tests, doc.go and test helpers excluded) whose callee is a function or method of this repository, with the function it runs; calls into the standard library, gin, gorm and other dependencies, and calls of local closures (buildQuery) are not labeled, so any target they get counts as a false positive. Methods promoted from embedded structs are labeled with the method's own type (ArticleSerializer.isFavoriteBy -> ArticleModel.isFavoriteBy).
